text: Started from 首页 floating 开始新训练: workout starts immediately, timer running, empty workout
Bench added collapsed (0/3 已完成, 3 empty sets by default), must tap card to expand. No prefill (dash placeholders), 上一个 column empty

Warm-up via tap set number -> sheet 选择组类型 -> 热身 (row shows W). Custom keypad, 下一步 on weight jumps to reps, 下一步 on reps marks set done and moves focus to next set weight. Rest timer default off -> no popup on first check. Warm-up counted in 训练量 (400 kg).
Next set row stays empty (dash), no copy of the previous set within session: same-as-previous set must be retyped
Last default set done -> keypad closes. Set 4 needs 添加组 (only 3 default sets)
添加组 adds a row prefilled with a copy of the previous set (60x8, not done). Tapping a filled field selects value, typing replaces.
E2 Dumbbell Incline Bench Press: weight header shows dumbbell icon x2 Kg = per-hand entry, volume doubles. New card collapses Bench (accordion).
hit-test for the . key was misreported as rl_toolbar 384x792 (real target . key 85x46dp)

uiautomator fails (could not get idle state) while workout page is scrolled and the header ticking timer shows -> hit null. Real targets: keypad keys 85x46dp, 下一步 85x38dp, fields 72x48dp, 添加组 352x42dp

E3: closest = Lever Chest Press (first result for chest press, plate-loaded lever machine, no selectorized variant in top results). Card tap hit misreported as fragment_container, real target card header row 384x80dp
hit-test uses a stale dump when uiautomator fails (reported card_root / fragment_container). E3 s1 real targets: weight field 72x48, keys 85x46, 下一步 85x38
Chest Dip weight column header (+Kg): bodyweight + added, empty = BW
BW set: tapped reps field directly, 下一步 completed with weight empty. Focus jumps to next set (+Kg) field
添加组 row shows previous set values in grey, a single ✓ accepts them (same-as-previous = 2 taps when adding a set)
Finish page 完成训练: auto name 晨间训练, description, photo/video, date, duration 25m, activity type, session RPE (optional), 保存
After save: fullscreen 做得好！ share-card carousel (10 cards: streak etc) with 分享 button, closed via X top-left 42dp
Extra check: adding Bench Press (has history) in a new workout prefills all 4 sets with last numbers incl. W warm-up type (grey, one ✓ accepts), plus 上一个 column shows 40kg x 10 etc
再做一次 from home feed card ⋮ menu: new workout with 5 exercises, all collapsed, 0/4 已完成 each
No auto-advance to next exercise after last set, no rest popup (timer off)
Chest Dip prefill shows 0 in (+Kg) for BW sets, 上一个 shows '- x 12'
T3 hit-test entries in E4/E5 come from stale dumps (uiautomator idle failure while header timer ticks). Real targets: ✓ 48x48dp, card header 384x80dp
Edit done set: tap weight field (value selected), type 62.5, close keypad key. Set stays done. 训练量 header did not update (still 1 360 kg, should be 1 380)
Delete set: tap set number -> 删除该组 at bottom of sheet. No confirm, no undo snackbar, no global undo found. 训练量 refreshed to 1 380 now
Swipe-left on a set row deletes it immediately with snackbar 已移除的组 撤销 (few seconds). Undo restored the set. 训练量 header stale after undo (400 kg shown, real 900)
Long-press on a card collapses all cards into a drag list (drag reorder). My plain long press dropped Dumbbell Incline at the bottom
'overhead' alone returned triceps extensions first, needed 'overhead press'. Picked Barbell Seated Overhead Press
No Squat in this chest workout: target = move OHP to top, above Bench Press
Remove exercise: ⋮ -> 移除动作, no confirm, snackbar 已移除 ... 撤销
Home+relaunch: workout page as left. Force-stop+relaunch: opens straight into the in-progress workout, timer continued (0:04:25), sets intact, header now also shows PR 3
In-workout lookup: ⋮ -> 视频和历史 opens 关于 tab (video) by default, 历史 tab lists past sessions with per-set 1RM and PR medals, 进度 tab charts 预估力量 (79kg) and 训练量
动作 tab hit reported text 30x20, real tab 72x52dp
Export dialog: 这会将你的所有训练数据下载为 CSV 文件 (取消/导出). No Pro lock shown. Stopped before 导出 (would create a file), result after tap not tested
导入数据 opens Chrome at my.lyfta.app/auth/login?returnUrl=/import-tool (web import tool, needs web login). Did not log in
同步训练数据: re-sync then jumps back to home feed
Privacy default 谁可以看到你的训练 = 所有人 (public). Beta: 设定训练目标, 以图片形式分享模板. Theme light/dark/system. 12+ languages. Units global kg/lbs, km/mi, cm/in
